summary.text: Tonya Rush is a Democratic member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 67, who assumed office on January 8, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Rush is a healthcare provider and licensed realtor.

paragraphs.text: Tonya Rush attended Normandy High School.
Her career experience includes working as a healthcare provider, and she is also a licensed realtor in the state.
In the Missouri House, Rush was assigned to the House Economic Development Committee and the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee for 2025-2026.
